intro.uz: Gulnora buvisi haqida hikoya qiladi. Oʻqishdan oldin oʻylab koʻring: buvingiz yoki bobongiz har kuni nima qiladi?

paragraphs.en: My name is Gulnora. This is my grandmother, Saodat. She is seventy years old. She has got short grey hair and kind brown eyes. She always wears a white scarf and glasses.
paragraphs.uz: Mening ismim Gulnora. Bu — buvim, Saodat. U yetmish yoshda. Uning sochi kalta va oqargan, koʻzlari mehribon va jigarrang. U doim oq roʻmol oʻraydi va koʻzoynak taqadi.

paragraphs.en: My grandmother is a retired teacher. She doesn't work now, but she is always busy. She gets up at six every morning and makes tea for the family. She often makes somsa on Sundays.
paragraphs.uz: Buvim nafaqadagi oʻqituvchi. U hozir ishlamaydi, lekin doim band. U har kuni ertalab soat oltida turadi va oila uchun choy damlaydi. Yakshanba kunlari u tez-tez somsa pishiradi.

paragraphs.en: Fifty years ago, Grandma could run very fast. Now she can't run, but she walks in the park every evening. Her doctor says she should walk every day.
paragraphs.uz: Ellik yil oldin buvim juda tez yugura olardi. Hozir u yugura olmaydi, lekin har oqshom bogʻda sayr qiladi. Shifokori unga har kuni piyoda yurish kerakligini aytadi.

paragraphs.en: I love my grandmother. She tells me old stories and helps me with my homework.
paragraphs.uz: Men buvimni juda yaxshi koʻraman. U menga qadimiy hikoyalar aytib beradi va uy vazifamda yordam beradi.
